title: Flooding at Mallworld
content: It's in the title, for the past few weeks I've been having continuous dreams of mallworld and the hotel/transportation link being flooded. Giant waves coming from the sea outside, full shops swamped in water etc. I'm telling myself it's because there's flooding in the news but it's starting to freak me out and I'm just wondering if anyone else has experienced anything similar? I'm stressed to go to sleep cos it is INTENSE.
